recent: A cosy apartment music alcove beside a compact upright piano and a plain wooden metronome, illuminated by afternoon window light — After practising a simple steady rhythm, she reaches below the piano bench to retrieve the metronome's little winding key that has rolled onto the floor

A quiet community seed-exchange room in a renovated railway goods shed, sunlight crossing a long plain wooden counter — She turns the side handle of a little wooden seed sieve, catching the cleaned seeds in a shallow bowl before putting them into blank paper envelopes
a glass and pottery workshop with a glowing kiln — holds a small glass jar of clear oil at chest height
a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — brings a small bouquet up to her face to smell the flowers
a training gym with a heavy bag — dries her hair with a towel
an inn or tavern of her element's kingdom at night — standing
a hilltop observatory with its dome open to a clear night sky — standing

A sunny outdoor aquatic exercise garden with a narrow stepping-stone balance channel, a dry tiled walkway and a low wooden rail — She steps from one broad dry stepping stone to the next after a gentle balance session, lifting her knee to clear the small gap and smiling at the tiny rhythmic ripples below
a marble quarry of stepped white terraces — seated sideways on a stool or bench
a military camp tent or ready room in her element's kingdom — kneeling on the ground
an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing
a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height
a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a short coil of silvery magnesium ribbon tied in both hands in front of her
